prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent standing-cardinal game-character source sheet
Primary request: Create one new ordinary clinic patient in everyday civilian clothes. Image1 controls only accepted v6a rounded pixel-art style and proportional scale, not its identity or clothes.
Subject: a 49-year-old adult woman with fair freckled skin, a straight ginger shoulder-length bob with outward-flipped ends and side-swept bangs, small pearl stud earrings and no glasses, and a athletic build. They wear a pale-lavender full-sleeved turtleneck, a navy denim knee-length skirt with large patch pockets, charcoal tights and plum trainers. All sleeves are full length to the wrists. No badge, lanyard, scrubs or white coat. Calm friendly expression, arms relaxed at the sides.
Composition/framing: exactly four isolated full-body standing figures in one horizontal row, left-to-right SOUTH/front, EAST/true profile facing screen-right, WEST/true profile facing screen-left, NORTH/rear. Same identity, face, hair, outfit, head and body scale across all four views. Every head and shoe fully visible, with broad transparent gutters and outer margins.
Style/medium: compact rounded proportions, large expressive head, crisp softly shaded pixel art and clean dark pixel-stepped outline matching Image1.
Constraints: genuine transparent RGBA background. No hat, chair, furniture, floor, cast shadow, glow, props, devices, scenery, text, readable badge, logo, watermark, collage, grid, extra people, varied poses or cropped limbs.
